LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.2: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: Why do we use different units of measuring length? 2. How do we measure the perimeter of different objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: A learner develops speaking, listening and teamwork as they work in pairs/groups

when measuring lengths of various objects and also as they discuss the relationship between circumference and diameter.

● Self-efficacy: A learner develops high self-esteem as they practise different operations using length.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner develops interpretation and inference skills as they relate circumference

to diameter.

Values:
● Integrity: A learner enhances honesty as they carry out the activities and give the correct measurement.

● Unity: A learner enhances cooperation as they work in groups measuring lengths of various objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: A learner works in pairs and groups in measuring lengths of various objects.

● Global citizenship: A learner appreciates units of measurements especially the SI units of length.

33

Link to other subjects:

● Integrated Science: A learner uses units of measuring length.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Tape Measure, Metre Rule, Tactile circular objects, digital devices with assistive technology such as magnifiers,

refreshable braille displays., Print and Braille Course Book.
